sampled.description: Whether the sampling decision was sampled or not, false can mean either not sampled or dropped

feature_gates.description: When enabled, a new metric stat_count_bytes_sampled will be available in the tail sampling processor. Differently from stat_count_traces_sampled, this metric will count the number of bytes sampled or not per sampling policy, where the original counts traces.

When enabled, a new metric stat_count_spans_sampled will be available in the tail sampling processor. Differently from stat_count_traces_sampled, this metric will count the number of spans sampled or not per sampling policy, where the original counts traces.

When enabled, attaches the name of the policy (and if applicable, composite policy) responsible for sampling a trace in the 'tailsampling.policy', 'tailsampling.composite_policy', and `tailsampling.cached_decision` attributes.
When enabled, allows configuring tail_storage to use a tail storage extension implementation.

When enabled, sampling policies consult OpenTelemetry probability sampling information carried in W3C tracestate (the 'rv' and 'th' fields of the 'ot' section). The 'probabilistic' policy uses tracestate randomness for its sampling decision (falling back to the legacy FNV trace ID hash when no tracestate sampling info is present), and the processor rewrites the outgoing 'th' on sampled traces to the effective threshold across all matched policies.

processor_tail_sampling_count_bytes_samp.description: Count of bytes that were sampled or not per sampling policy

processor_tail_sampling_count_spans_samp.description: Count of spans that were sampled or not per sampling policy

processor_tail_sampling_count_spans_with.description: Count of spans skipped while rewriting the effective `th` because their tracestate could not be parsed

processor_tail_sampling_count_traces_sam.description: Count of traces that were sampled or not per sampling policy

processor_tail_sampling_early_releases_f.description: Number of spans that were able to be immediately released due to a decision cache hit.

processor_tail_sampling_global_count_tra.description: Global count of traces that were sampled or not by at least one policy

processor_tail_sampling_new_trace_id_rec.description: Counts the arrival of new traces

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_decisio.description: Latency (in milliseconds) of each run of the sampling decision timer

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_late_sp.description: Time (in seconds) from the sampling decision was taken and the arrival of a late span

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_policy_.description: Count of sampling policy evaluation errors
Total number of executions of a specific sampling policy
Total time spent (in microseconds) executing a specific sampling policy

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_trace_d.description: Count of traces that needed to be dropped before the configured wait time

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_trace_r.description: Time (in seconds) from arrival of a new trace until its removal from memory

processor_tail_sampling_sampling_traces_.description: Tracks the number of traces current on memory

processor_tail_sampling_traces_dropped_t.description: Count of traces that were dropped because they were too large
